title: Grilled Chicken Kebabs
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make recipe featuring marinated chicken skewers grilled to perfection. Serve hot with your favorite sides.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with additional syrian if desired.
